_purpose: Data-driven registry of insecure-configuration-toggle patterns for scripts/scan_repo_surface.py (the same generic engine used for entrypoint-patterns.json -- 'kind' here is just a different label, no engine code changes needed). These are code-level security controls that can be disabled via a flag or environment variable, and where the disabled state is a single, unambiguous, well-known risk regardless of surrounding context -- unlike authorization/business-logic gaps, which need judgment and belong in analyze_workflows.py/the Business Logic & Abuse Case Agent instead.
_extend_instructions: Add a new entry here for any other 'well-known insecure toggle' (a specific flag/env-var name whose disabled/true/false state is unambiguously risky on its own, independent of what the surrounding code does) -- never add bespoke per-language detection code to scan_repo_surface.py. Good candidates: other TLS-verification bypasses, other signature-verification bypasses, other CORS-wildcard/credential-exposure flags, debug-mode-in-production flags. Each pattern's anchor_regex should encode the RISKY VALUE directly (e.g. '...:\s*true') so a match is inherently the risk, not just the presence of a configurable field.
